name: Laurence Donoghue
headline: Digital Business Transformations: Leadership, Execution, Sustainable Growth
about:
A seasoned technology leader helping clients around the world build and scale into disruptive competitors in their respective industries. 

Will you become the disruptor or be defeated by one?

The idea behind digital transformation as a driver of sustainable competitive advantage is not just about market positioning, but about out-thinking and out-performing the competition. Strategic thinking is about making sense of the future better than others, and then shaping that future to your advantage.

I provide consulting and execution of the NetSuite digital business platform. My clients commit to a transformational journey that begins with implementing rock solid financial and operational platforms. These tools enable enhanced customer experiences, fast response processes, and connectivity to their ecosystem of users and all stakeholders instantaneously.

Software implementation success begins with a solid understanding of the current state and a realistic path forward. I bring a passion for translating how that path will deliver transformative success.

NetSuite is the world's leading provider of cloud-based business management solutions. NetSuite helps companies manage core business processes with a single, fully integrated system covering ERP/financials, CRM, ecommerce, inventory and more. 

The NetSuite business management solution takes your business beyond traditional accounting software, streamlining back-office processes and equips you with the visibility you need to make better faster decisions.

- Single & Multi Entity Financial Management
- Sales Force & Marketing Automation (CRM)
- Supply Chain Management: Omni-Channel Distribution & Equipment Rental
- Discrete, Process & Contract Manufacturing
- Production quality control, regulatory & compliance
- SuiteCommerce: B2B, B2C eCommerce
- Service Resource Planning: Project Management, Field Service & Customer Support
- Business Analytics: Reporting & Dashboard Development
… more
